checks: For each anchor the convex coefficient polytope is nonempty, bounded and rational. Its vertices solve full-rank active rational systems. The preservation equations at these finitely many vertices imply all anchored equations, so L(U) is a rational kernel. Clearing denominators of added generators preserves their span with the original coordinates and constant.
Coordinate expansions in the two spanning systems yield affine maps between the integer graph and canonical lift; their compositions fix spanning sets and hence the respective affine hulls.

An integer point of the lifted hull projects to an integer anchor in U by original completeness. The combination defining that point is anchored at the projection, so every added coordinate is forced. Conversely each graph site is integral. Integer differences of graph sites span E_0; its intersection with the ambient integer lattice is discrete and contains those spanning differences, giving full rank also in rank zero. Its translate by the integer anchor is exactly the ambient integer trace of the affine hull.

Forward divisibility projects an integral quotient to an original integral quotient. For m≥2 in reverse, w=v+(u−v)/m is an integer point of the segment and hence in U. Its anchored representation gives f_i(u)−f_i(v)=m(f_i(w)−f_i(v)). The entire quotient is integral and lies in the linear space E_0, so it belongs to the inherited lattice. The cases m=1 and u=v are immediate.

The m=2 equivalence identifies the occupied classes. An independent exact rank increase example is the four corners of the unit square with added f(x,y)=xy. The original corners have no nontrivial anchored representations, and the three lifted differences from the origin have determinant one. The lift has rank three but still uses only the four original parity classes.

An integer point in the hull of a closed minor first belongs to U and then to the minor; the argument repeats in inherited lattice basis coordinates. Verified source hash and 2086e4eaa4bce465 §§1–5, (1)–(7). No subsequent conditional attainment claim is assumed.
